description: This file defines an interface IAsyncBatchProducer in the Orleans.Streams namespace. The interface extends IAsyncObserver to support batch production of items in a streaming context, including a method for passing batches of items asynchronously.

classes.name: IAsyncBatchProducer<T>
classes.description: An interface that generalizes IAsyncObserver to allow production of batches of items and includes a method for passing item batches asynchronously.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously passes a batch of items to the consumer and returns a Task that completes when the batch has been fully processed and accepted.
